description: Implementation of a Single Producer Single Consumer (SPSC) lock-free ring buffer for inter-thread communication in Zephyr OS, including buffer initialization, allocation, commit, read, free, and utilization functions.

methods.name: spsc_pbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes the ring buffer with provided memory, size, and flags.

methods.name: spsc_pbuf_alloc
methods.description: Allocates space in the buffer for a message of specified length.

methods.name: spsc_pbuf_commit
methods.description: Commits the allocated message, updating write index.

methods.name: spsc_pbuf_write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer as a message.

methods.name: spsc_pbuf_claim
methods.description: Claims a message from the buffer for reading.

methods.name: spsc_pbuf_free
methods.description: Frees the message after reading, updating read index.

methods.name: spsc_pbuf_read
methods.description: Reads a message from the buffer into provided buffer.

methods.name: spsc_pbuf_get_utilization
methods.description: Returns current buffer utilization if enabled.
